$comment: Single source of truth for scope (Lesson 8). Every feature carries the triple: behavior + verification + state, plus evidence. Only the checker/verification script flips status to passing/done (Lesson 9). Replace these placeholders with real features whose verification is a runnable command. attempts/maxAttempts is a timebox: the maker increments attempts on every iteration it works a feature and MUST set status=blocked (with a reason in checkerNotes) once attempts reaches maxAttempts, instead of continuing to retry indefinitely — this is what stops a hard problem from silently consuming an unbounded loop budget. Each feature also carries kind (build|prove) and falsifier: the specific wrong implementation its verification would fail on. A verification whose falsifier you cannot name does not discriminate — see docs/reference/test-authoring.md.

features.name: Baseline green
features.behavior: Project installs deps, runs the baseline gate to green, and starts from a clean checkout
features.falsifier: a gate that exits 0 without running anything — or one that runs a failing step and swallows it, which the bash version did — the baseline must be able to go red
